title: 21 August Grenade Attack
subtitle: A grenade attack targets an Awami League rally in Dhaka.
summary: On 21 August 2004, grenades were thrown at an Awami League rally in Dhaka, killing and injuring many people and nearly killing Sheikh Hasina. The attack became a defining episode of armed political violence in contemporary Bangladesh.
heroTagline: A grenade attack targets an Awami League rally in Dhaka.
whyItMatters: The attack is essential for understanding political violence and party memory after 1991.
